notes: Community Airdrop uses a Dynamic Conversion Mechanism: River Points convert into Staked RIVER over a 180-day window with a continuously increasing conversion rate.
The 30% allocation to the Community Airdrop is a maximum; unallocated tokens (due to early conversions at lower rates) remains as Community Reserve
The unlocked portion of the Community Airdrop allocation is tracked onchain, the rest is marked as TBD

Community Airdrop.methodology: Dynamic Conversion, River points convert into RIVER over a 180-day window at an ascending rate.

points-converted.name: Points Converted
points-converted.methodology: RIVER distributed via PointsConverted events (no penalty)

Community Airdrop (TBD).methodology: Remaining RIVER from 30% allocation not yet distributed through conversions
